description: Updates a pricing rule for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because pricing rules can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

body.description: WAPI PricingRulesUpdateRequest body: RuleId and supported rule fields.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_update_pricing_rule
title: Update Pricing Rule
